title: Phase 0: Model Schema Validation
description:
Make the existing Model primitive actually validate its inputs and outputs using Pydantic. Currently input_schema and output_schema are parsed from .tac declarations but never enforced. This phase adds real validation at the predict() boundary.

Part of the Model Primitive MLOps vision (docs/MODEL_PRIMITIVE_PLAN.md). Parent of Tactus-87f.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
